item.title: Bring lunch to a drawing day
item.context_text: Your group is going to a drawing class. You are sending a message about lunch to a friend.
item.objective_text: Plan a safe lunch and tell a friend what to bring.
success_conditions: Plan a safe lunch and tell a friend what to bring.

children.title: Read the class note
children.instructions: Read closely and use the details to answer.
children.prompt_text: Drawing day is on Saturday. Bring a water bottle and your own lunch. Please do not bring peanuts. There is a tap by the classroom.

questions.prompt: What should each person bring besides lunch?
questions.explanation: The note requests a water bottle.
The note asks people to leave peanuts at home.

children.title: Hear a friend at the shop
children.instructions: Listen twice. First identify the update, then check the details you need.
children.prompt_text: I can buy cheese sandwiches or peanut sandwiches. The cheese ones are next to the fruit. I already have a bottle. Would you like an apple as well?

questions.prompt: Which sandwiches fit the class rule?
questions.explanation: The plain cheese option meets the no-peanut instruction.

questions.prompt: What does your friend already have?
questions.explanation: The friend says they already have a bottle.

children.title: Make a short request
children.prompt_text: Your friend is still at the shop. Ask for lunch and say why.
children.instructions: Say what you want. Then make the peanut rule clear without blaming anyone.
children.goal: Give an actionable response to what you just learned.
children.model_answer: Please buy two cheese sandwiches and two apples. We cannot bring peanuts to the classroom. I already have a bottle for water.

children.title: Send a note for Saturday
children.prompt_text: Your friend is sharing your message with another classmate who did not see the class note.
children.instructions: List what to bring and what to leave at home. Say where to get more water. Check your note can be read quickly.
children.goal: Plan a safe lunch and tell a friend what to bring.
children.model_answer: Hi! Bring a cheese sandwich or another lunch without peanuts on Saturday. Please take your water bottle and some fruit. There is a tap by the classroom if you need more water. See you there!
